sources.issuerHoldings: Official issuer product pages/CSV download notices and official financial statements

evaluation.flags: O confirmed with public evidence; X confirmed negative; no residual '?' in this 3-gate prescreen
evaluation.themeRelevance: Separate step; R14 thematic priority does not auto-pass
evaluation.providerLookups: GET /api/v1/symbols?source=stocks&timeframe=1m&prefix=TICKER&limit=25; ensure .symbols[].symbol exactly TICKER; require rows>0.
evaluation.marketDataLicenseRestriction: Derived public indicators allowed only if raw bars cannot be reconstructed. Raw bar redistribution forbidden. Hourly free API; 48-hour delayed; no guarantee of 252 continuous trading sessions or live freshness.

operatorRubric.registration: 25 if SEC official roster SEC Current Status=Approved and recent ADV date; else 0
operatorRubric.disciplinary: 25 if Item11 Y fields=0, 18 if 1, 14 if 2-3, 10 if 4-8, 5 if 9-11, 0 if >=12; an Item11 Y is a disclosure flag, not one incident or verified ongoing sanction
operatorRubric.disclosure: 15 if recent Form ADV plus 10 if official complete holdings disclosures evidenced on candidate funds, else 5; for current dataset all get 25
operatorRubric.grade: A >=90, B 75-89, C 60-74, D <60; A capped to B for any Item11 affirmative or firm tenure under 5y
operatorRubric.registrationInfoCaution: SEC data based on Form ADV filers; regulator does not endorse advisers and statements are not independently guaranteed; firm crosswalk is provisional at ETF trust level

specialCautions: Ticker existence does NOT independently prove symbol identity throughout historic rows (ticker reuse) nor sufficient actual trading sessions.
RBTX and LLMA newly listed: need actual >=40 sessions before adaptive score; no such score calculated.
Thinly traded symbols KYC, LATR, CBOT, PSWD etc can have sparse minute bars; catalog presence is not 252-trading-day completion.
GetMarketHistory stock prices are unadjusted for splits/dividends, newer than 48h not available; future operational choice must respect original formula/data contracts.
CLOD, URAN, NATO, SPAM issuer pages return 403 to direct page readers, but search-indexed first-party snippets explicitly advertise Full Holdings CSV.
FCLD holding evidence is semiannual direct investments schedule rather than creation/redemption basket; more recent daily public disclosure should be verified before automation.
Adviser Item11 Y implies a reported disclosure item; not proof of guilt, current prohibition, or clean regulatory history. Adviser score is ZGMINI research grade, not SEC rating.
All existing production ETF rosters, scores, DB, collection jobs, and GitHub main untouched.
